Rent Collection Tracker

Automated rent tracking with late fee calculations, arrears register, and dashboard KPIs. Track payments, outstanding balances, and tenant history across unlimited properties and units.

What's Included

  • Automated Excel Workbooks: 7 sheets with formulas, dashboards, and auto-calculations
  • Payment Register: Track rent received, outstanding balances, and late fees
  • Arrears Dashboard: KPI summary showing total arrears, number of defaulters, and collection rate
  • Late Fee Calculator: Automatic calculations based on Act 220 and L.I. 369 regulations
  • Tenant History: Payment performance analysis and trends
  • PDF Guide: Instructions for property managers and landlords
  • WhatsApp Cards: 5 marketing cards for social media (Portfolio tier only)
  • Offline-first: Works in Excel or Google Sheets. No cloud, no subscriptions.
